name: cor-kitaev-diagonal-cpization
source: imports validated registry lemma proofs/cor-kitaev-diagonal-cpization — Entrywise CP-ization from the repaired diagonal: for the finite phase-balanced diagonal D=sum_t q_t W_t^dagger tensor W_t supplied by lem-kitaev-diagonal-repair, every involution-preserving linear map tilde-Delta:B->B(H) and every UCP map Phi define a completely positive map Delta'(X)=sum_t q_t Phi(tilde-Delta(X W_t^dagger) tilde-Delta(W_t)); complete positivity uses exact centrality of D and does not require exact multiplicativity of tilde-Delta.
